# Godot MCP Toolkit

> A Godot 4.2+ editor plugin (GDScript) that exposes the editor and the running
> game to AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol. It pairs with a
> companion npm package, `@npgamedev/godot-mcp-server`, which is the MCP bridge
> the assistant actually talks to: the plugin hosts localhost WebSocket servers
> inside the editor and the running game; the server translates MCP tool calls
> into those channels.

This repository ships the editor plugin (`addons/godot_mcp_toolkit/`) via the
Godot Asset Library. The repository root is also the development Godot project.
The server lives in its own repository and installs from npm.

## Docs

- [Documentation map](docs/README.md): every docs surface, organized by what
  you want to do (use, extend, contribute).
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/README.md): subsystems, the editor/runtime
  split, transport and contract surface, key decisions, with diagrams.
- [Compatibility](addons/godot_mcp_toolkit/docs/compatibility.md): supported
  Godot versions, per-version tool behavior, headless mode, C# requirements,
  export stripping.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): the 60-second checklist,
  connectivity probe, and symptom-to-fix entries.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability, the security
  model, and hardening guidance.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): environment setup, checks, commit format,
  and the documentation rules.

## Companion server (godot-mcp-server)

- [Tool reference](https://github.com/NPGameDev/godot-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/tool-reference/README.md):
  generated reference of every tool and operation — the canonical list.
- [Token efficiency](https://github.com/NPGameDev/godot-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/token-efficiency.md):
  measured context-window cost of the tool surface.
